findings.current: Beyond the sky, which turned red in an instant, more than a dozen fireballs emerged from between the storm clouds and took aim above the Black Dragon’s head.
findings.defect: The fireballs are aimed at the dragon’s head, not at a point above it. 십여 개 is roughly ten or a dozen, not necessarily more than twelve.
findings.rationale: 머리 위를 향해 identifies the dragon’s head as the target; 십여 개 gives an approximate count.
findings.replacement: Against the suddenly reddened sky, a dozen or so fireballs emerged from the storm clouds and took aim at the Black Dragon’s head.
findings.source: 일순간 붉게 물든 하늘 너머, 먹구름 사이로 모습을 드러낸 십여 개의 화염구가 흑룡의 머리 위를 향해 겨누어졌다.

findings.current: Far away, Magic Johnson—who had risked himself to step in while the Guardians were fighting—coughed up blood and dropped to his knees.
findings.defect: The draft makes the Guardians’ fight sound separate from Johnson. He intervenes at risk to himself during his fight with them.
findings.rationale: 가디언들과의 일전 describes a battle against the Guardians, not merely a time when they were fighting.
findings.replacement: Far away, Magic Johnson—who had risked intervening in the middle of his fight with the Guardians—coughed up blood and dropped to his knees.
findings.source: 저 멀리 가디언들과의 일전 도중 위험을 감수하고 나선 매직 존슨이 피를 토하며 무릎을 꿇었다.

findings.current: as the Dragon’s enormous shadow loomed over him like Mount Taishan
findings.defect: Capitalizing the mountain image as Mount Taishan introduces an apparent reference to the named character Taishan.
findings.rationale: 태산처럼 functions here as an image of immense size, not a reference to the character.
findings.replacement: as the Dragon’s enormous shadow loomed over him like a mountain
findings.source: 태산처럼 드리워진 용의 거대한 그림자가 가까워졌을 때

findings.current: Master of the lofty Silver Mountains, and Archduke of the Demon Realm.
findings.defect: The source names a singular mountain; the draft changes it to a range.
findings.rationale: 산 is singular here, with no indication of multiple mountains.
findings.replacement: Master of the lofty Silver Mountain, and Archduke of the Demon Realm.
findings.source: 드높은 은빛 산의 주인이자, 마계의 대공.

findings.current: The spearhead, imbued with its wielder’s will, pierced the last trace his friend had left behind.
findings.defect: “Pierced” implies the spearhead passes through the trace; the source says it bites into the existing wound.
findings.rationale: 파고들었다 describes driving into something, without establishing that the spearhead passed through it.
findings.replacement: The spearhead, imbued with its wielder’s will, bit into the last trace his friend had left behind.
findings.source: 주인의 의지가 깃든 창날이, 친구의 마지막 흔적을 파고들었다.

summary: The draft preserves the main exchange, but changes the fireballs’ target, obscures who is fighting the Guardians, and adds an unintended proper-name reference.
